notes.title: Check out the new demo for party-based RPG Call of Saregnar
notes.notes:
Giving a firm nod to classic 90s RPGs, you can try out a brand new demo for the upcoming Call of Saregnar.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/01/check-out-the-new-demo-for-party-based-rpg-call-of-saregnar

notes.title: Call of Saregnar is a nod to 90s party-based RPGs and it's on the way to Linux
notes.notes:
Do you miss earlier party-based RPGs? Call of Saregnar is an in development title from Damjan Mozetič inspired by the likes of Betrayal at Krondor, TES: Daggerfall and Realms of Arkania.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/09/call-of-saregnar-is-a-nod-to-90s-party-based-rpgs-and-its-on-the-way-to-linux
